intro: Thursday brings a housing application pause in Port Coquitlam, new tools for Linux security and experiments in AI voice and model serving. Wednesday’s market close, a January performance and a mountain dining menu offer more to plan around.

stories.title: Port Coquitlam pauses some new housing applications
stories.summary: Port Coquitlam council voted to suspend consideration of new applications relying on BC’s small-scale housing rules. Mayor Brad West says applications already in the system are unaffected; staff will review the city’s zoning for smaller homes.

stories.title: OpenAI and Cisco open-source a Linux protection runtime
stories.summary: OpenAI and Cisco introduced Shirudo, an open-source runtime for testing and deploying temporary protections on running Linux systems. It uses eBPF to target vulnerable behaviour while operators prepare patches, with security teams controlling deployment.

stories.title: Nvidia releases document-training datasets
stories.summary: Nvidia published three synthetic datasets used to train Nemotron 3.5 Parse, covering charts, tables and multilingual document pages. Images, annotations and generation documentation give developers material for fine-tuning document-reading models and creating variations.

stories.title: IBM demonstrates a multilingual farming assistant
stories.summary: IBM Research describes a voice agent built with the CUGA harness that answers farming questions using an English agricultural handbook. It returns spoken answers in the question’s language and displays source pages so users can check the response.

stories.title: A coding agent tunes inference on a single GPU
stories.summary: A Hugging Face experiment used a coding agent to explore serving configurations for Inkling 2 Mini on one RTX PRO 6000 GPU. The walkthrough shares measurements and deployment lessons, including approaches that did not work.

stories.title: Toronto stocks recover from a steep morning drop
stories.summary: The S&P/TSX Composite closed up 217.69 points Wednesday after falling more than 700 points earlier in the session. US indexes also recovered much of their intraday losses, though the S&P 500 and Nasdaq still finished lower.

events.date: 2027-01-27 · Roundhouse Community Arts & Recreation Centre, 181 Roundhouse Mews, Vancouver
events.title: Creation Paradigm brings a looping performance to PuSh
events.description: Joshua Serafin’s Creation Paradigm runs at the Roundhouse January 27–31 as part of the PuSh International Performing Arts Festival. The highly visual performance runs on a 25-minute loop; the organizer notes that it contains nudity.

dining.date: From 2026-11-19 · The Observatory, Grouse Mountain, North Vancouver
dining.title: The Observatory introduces its winter menu
dining.description: Chef Alex Uza’s new alpine-inspired menu includes game hen and bone-in pork schnitzel, alongside seasonal cocktails and a refreshed wine list. Grouse Mountain says reservations include mountain admission from 4 p.m.
